title: Is It Better to Book a Madeira Boat Trip Direct or Through GetYourGuide?
description: It is the same boat, skipper and route either way. Booking direct means dealing with us. GetYourGuide is handy for one app, its own rules and its own support.
heroAlt: A white motor boat stopped in calm water off Ribeira Brava, the village and valley behind

Two guests sit on the bow, small and seen from behind, one with legs over the side. Behind the boat, the dark pebble beach, the white church tower and houses of the village at the mouth of a deep green valley, steep slopes on both sides.
